pairs: et spiritus anxius clamat ad te.
and the troubled spirit cry out to you.
for you are a merciful God,
and so be merciful to us,
for we have sinned before you.
For you are enthroned in eternity,
but we will pass away in time.
O Lord Almighty, the God of Israel,
listen now to the prayer of the dead of Israel and of their sons,
et filiorum ipsorum qui peccaverunt ante te, et non audierunt vocem Domini Dei sui,
who have sinned before you and have not listened to the voice of the Lord their God,
and have joined themselves to evil.
Remember not the iniquities of our fathers,
sed memento manus tuæ et nominis tui in tempore isto:
but remember your hand and your name at this time.
quia tu es Dominus Deus noster,
For you are the Lord our God,
quia propter hoc dedisti timorem tuum in cordibus nostris,
And for this reason, you have imparted your fear into our hearts,
et ut invocemus nomen tuum, et laudemus te in captivitate nostra,
and also, so that we may call upon your name and may praise you in our captivity,
quia convertimur ab iniquitate patrum nostrorum,
for we are converted from the iniquity of our fathers,
Et ecce nos in captivitate nostra sumus hodie,
And, behold, we are still in our captivity on this day,
where you have scattered us into disgrace,
according to all the iniquities of our fathers,
so that you may learn prudence!
that you are in the land of your enemies,
that you have grown old in a foreign land,
that you are defiled with the dead,
deputatus es cum descendentibus in infernum?
that you are regarded as among those who are descending into hell?
You have forsaken the fountain of wisdom.
nam si in via Dei ambulasses,
For if you had walked in the way of God,
you would certainly have lived in everlasting peace.
ut scias simul ubi sit longiturnitas vitæ et victus,
so that you may know at the same time where long life and prosperity are,
ubi sit lumen oculorum, et pax.
where the light of the eyes and peace are.
et quis intravit in thesauros ejus?
And who has entered its treasure chamber?
Where are the leaders of the peoples,
et qui dominantur super bestias quæ sunt super terram?
and those who rule over the beasts that are upon the earth,
who play among the birds of the air,
who store up treasures of silver
et non est finis acquisitionis eorum?
and with whom there is no end to their acquiring,
and others are risen up in their place.
The youth have seen the light
and have dwelt upon the earth,
yet they are ignorant of the way of instruction.
They have neither understood the paths of it,
nor have their sons accepted it.
a facie ipsorum longe facta est;
It is far from their face.
non est audita in terra Chanaan,
It has not been heard of in the land of Canaan,
nor has it been seen in Teman.
It is likewise with the sons of Hagar,
qui exquirunt prudentiam quæ de terra est,
who search for the practicality that is of the earth,
the negotiators of Merran and Teman,
and the searchers of discretion and intelligence.
Yet the way of wisdom they have not known,
nor have they called to mind its paths.
how great is the house of God,
and how vast is the place of his possession!
There were those who were called giants,
The Lord did not choose them,
nor did they discover the way of instruction;
and, because they did not have wisdom,
they passed away as a result of their foolishness.
Who has gone up into heaven,
and brought her down from the clouds?
et attulit illam super aurum electum?
and brought her, chosen instead of gold?
Non est qui possit scire vias ejus,
There is no one who is able to know her ways,
nor any who can search out her paths.
sed qui scit universa novit eam,
Yet he who knows the universe is familiar with her,
et adinvenit eam prudentia sua qui præparavit terram in æterno tempore:
and in his foresight he invented her,
he who prepared the earth for time without end,
and filled it with cattle and four-footed beasts,
and it obeyed him in fear.
Stellæ autem dederunt lumen in custodiis suis,
Yet the stars have given light from their posts,
et luxerunt ei cum jucunditate, qui fecit illas.
and they shined with cheerfulness to him who made them.
et non æstimabitur alius adversus eum.
and no other can compare to him.
He invented the way of all instruction,
et tradidit illam Jacob puero suo,
and delivered it to Jacob his child,
Post hæc in terris visus est,
After this, he was seen on earth,
